desc:
Welcome to Jujutsu Randomizer!

Step into the arena, unleash random Jujutsu Kaisen-inspired powers, and dominate every round!
Win rounds, stack up Yen, and unlock awesome characters, titles, finishers, and other cosmetics!

⚔️ Game Highlights
65 unique characters to unlock
New characters, content, and updates on the way
Different abilities and movesets every round

🎮 Supported Devices
PC, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox, and PlayStation

⭐ Like and favorite the game for more updates!
